description: Thin wrapper over ovos-stt-plugin-whisper pinned to the MyNorthAI Portuguese Whisper checkpoints. This fighter runs the small tier (my-north-ai/whisper-small-pt), hard-locked to Portuguese.
notes: Model-size variant of the MyNorthAI whisper wrapper; 'model' accepts the alias directly (small/medium/large-v3), which the plugin resolves to the full HF repo id and hard-locks lang to pt.
